narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Sales grew from 13851.0 in Jun 2025 to 16199.0 in Sep 2026.

promises.credibility: Management guidance is largely focused on future horizons (such as FY27 transactions and R&D), leaving most near-term actionable promises pending verification.

bull: Strong balance sheet with a low debt to equity ratio of 0.04, improving from 0.05 three periods ago.
Substantial investments of ₹16,449 Cr easily exceed borrowings of ₹3,241 Cr.
Robust five year cumulative cash flow from operations is 1.20 times PAT reaching ₹52,570 Cr.
bear: Latest quarter PAT declined by 36% YoY alongside a margin drop of 2.0 percentage points to 29.3%.
Revenue growth shows a slight deceleration with a 3-year CAGR of 10% compared to 12% over 5 years.
Latest quarter EBITDA growth slowed to 5% YoY despite revenue increasing by 12% YoY.
bull_bear.what_would_change_my_mind: PAT returning to positive YoY growth alongside margin expansion.
